**Note added by Josefin Lundgren after the call, 2026-07-02:**

Faster loading step 1 retro. Biggest push of the year so far: about 85 hours plus 4,000 EUR paid. No leads. Customers noticed the speed; the groups who complained most read "twice as fast" as a promise we didn't keep (Sydfood: "Faster at what?").

Why it got the full treatment: it had been promised since December, product had worked on it for half a year, and we sized the launch by those two things.

What we didn't do that month: follow up the 118 people from the reporting templates webinar; anything for the supplier comparison (April), which sales and CS keep using.

Rule for next time, to try in Q3: decide the size before anyone writes, on the same questions every time, asked by product marketing with the PM. Frida to write it up. Send every all customer email to CS and the PM the day before.
